snippet.title: Boggle Party Trailer - Next Games, A Netflix Game Studio
snippet.description:
What's the word? 📱
Introducing Boggle Party, available now on your smart TV’s Netflix app.
Race against the clock to find words (the longer, the better) in a jumbled-up letter grid. Play solo, or make it a couch party with up to eight players.
